objective: Implement the minimal read-only portable integrity verifier that makes the accepted V4-T1 RED suite GREEN without changing existing validator behavior.
deliverable: A single standard-library verify_integrity.py module and an evidence-bearing worker receipt.
read_scope: fixtures/adaptive-task-orchestrator-write-dag/ (entire fixture, read-only except the declared tool file)
write_scope: Automatically cleaned unittest TemporaryDirectory paths outside the repository

authoritative_facts: V4-T1@1 must be accepted with retained RED evidence before this task starts.
The manifest grammar, finding codes, quiescent-package boundary, supported matrix, and non-goals are fixed by the approved specification.
The public function returns a deterministic sorted list of immutable findings; the CLI returns 0 for no findings, 1 for findings, and argparse-controlled 2 for usage errors.
Accepted v0.2 and v0.3 bytes and validate_evidence.py behavior are immutable.
accepted_upstream_results: V4-T1@1 exact targeted RED result and accepted test module.
user_constraints: Standard library only; no dependency install, network, external runtime, historical package mutation, public push, tag, or release.
permissions: Edit only verify_integrity.py and use automatically cleaned temporary directories while running tests.
non_goals: Do not change tests to manufacture GREEN, alter validate_evidence.py, add a manifest generator, add signatures, claim authenticity, or broaden into strict closure/crash recovery/second-domain work.

acceptance_checks: Make the unchanged accepted V4-T1 targeted test module pass without weakening or skipping any test.
Make the complete fixture unittest suite pass.
Accept the unchanged v0.2 100-entry and v0.3 65-entry manifests with zero findings.
Emit the exact stable finding sets required for malformed input, unsafe paths, incomplete inventory, unsupported objects, read failures, and digest mismatch.
Prove two validations are repeatable and package inventories/digests remain unchanged under python -B.
Modify no file outside the declared tool path.
evidence_required: targeted GREEN command, test count, and exit status
full-suite command, test count, and exit status
v0.2 and v0.3 verifier outputs and entry counts
